children: The one Super Saturday of the earnings season is here. India's two largest private sector lenders, HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank are set to report their September quarter results during the course of the day. That's not it. Their peer lenders, Axis Bank and YES Bank, which has been in the news all through Thursday and Friday will also be reporting their results. For HDFC Bank, the street will focus on their margin profile, asset quality, and of course, their Succession Plan with Anup Bagchi taking charge at the end of the month. ICICI Bank's resilience will be in focus while for YES Bank, the focus will be on how will the lender deal with the AT-1 impact. Apart from these banks, some other broader market companies such as Central Bank of India, IDBI Bank, which has also been in the news, and India Cements, will also be coming out with their numbers during the course of the day. HDFC Bank shares are looking to recover from 52-week low levels, while YES Bank has shed nearly 20% in the last two sessions. Watch this space for all the LIVE Q2 results updates from these banks and other companies.

title: Q2 Results LIVE Updates: Axis Bank's operating profit may grow 13%; Yes Bank earnings eyed
